intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Welcome to the Mars Detective Club, Captain Pebble.

intro.speaker: ziggy
intro.text: Beep boop! Hi Captain! I'm Ziggy, your flying detective assistant. I'm 87% genius and 13% propeller.

intro.speaker: ziggy
intro.text: Our first case is a BIG one: Case #001. Did Mars ever have water?

intro.speaker: ziggy
intro.text: Nope! Real detectives follow clues. NASA left three old machines on Mars, and each one found a different piece of the puzzle.

intro.speaker: ziggy
intro.text: Find them, scan them, and collect 3 Evidence Cards. Then we crack the case together!

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: This is a virtual Mars. The real machines landed thousands of kilometers apart, so their true landing sites are written in your Journal.

viking1_intro.speaker: ziggy
viking1_intro.text: Look! An old lander with long legs. That's Viking 1. It landed in 1976!

viking1_intro.speaker: ziggy
viking1_intro.text: It did experiments on Mars soil. Was it growing potatoes or what?

viking1_intro.speaker: ziggy
viking1_intro.text: Okay, okay, no potatoes. It was hunting for signs of LIFE. Let's open its file!

viking1_outro.speaker: ziggy
viking1_outro.text: So the soil did strange things, but that is NOT proof of life. Good detectives never jump to conclusions!

viking1_outro.speaker: pebble
viking1_outro.text: And after six years, one wrong command from Earth silenced it. Poor Viking.

viking1_outro.speaker: ziggy
viking1_outro.text: Clue #1 saved. Follow the arrow to the next machine!

opportunity_intro.speaker: ziggy
opportunity_intro.text: Whoa, a rover with solar panels! Meet Opportunity.

opportunity_intro.speaker: pebble
opportunity_intro.text: It looks small for a whole planet.

opportunity_intro.speaker: ziggy
opportunity_intro.text: Small but tough! It was built to work for about 90 days... and it kept going for almost 15 YEARS.

opportunity_intro.speaker: ziggy
opportunity_intro.text: It read rocks like a book. Hey, is this rock older than my grandpa?

opportunity_intro.speaker: pebble
opportunity_intro.text: Ziggy, that rock was old before your grandpa was even born!

opportunity_outro.speaker: ziggy
opportunity_outro.text: Rocks soaked by water, and little blueberries made inside them! Mars had liquid water a very long time ago.

opportunity_outro.speaker: pebble
opportunity_outro.text: Then a giant dust storm hid the Sun from its solar panels.

opportunity_outro.speaker: ziggy
opportunity_outro.text: Clue #2 saved. One more machine is waiting for us!

phoenix_intro.speaker: ziggy
phoenix_intro.text: Brrr! It's chilly up here in the far north. That's the Phoenix lander!

phoenix_intro.speaker: ziggy
phoenix_intro.text: Phoenix had a robot arm built for digging. Like a treasure hunter with a shovel, but on Mars.

phoenix_intro.speaker: ziggy
phoenix_intro.text: Something hiding just under the dust. Let's find out!

phoenix_outro.speaker: ziggy
phoenix_outro.text: Wait... so there’s water here, but it’s hiding as ice?! Sneaky!

phoenix_outro.speaker: pebble
phoenix_outro.text: Summer ended, the Sun sank low, and Phoenix ran out of power.

case_ready.speaker: ziggy
case_ready.text: Captain! We have ALL 3 Evidence Cards!

case_ready.speaker: ziggy
case_ready.text: Time to put them on the case board and solve Case #001. Detective mode: ON!
